name: fertilizer
description: fertilizer is a cross-seeding tool for RED and OPS. Based on and inspired by crops. !! IMPORTANT !! 1. Click "Basic View" in the upper right 2. Edit the "-o" flag in "Post Arguments" to match your preferences. The default is good for most users, but you should be aware of it. See the docs on installation for more info: https://github.com/moleculekayak/fertilizer/wiki

paths.name: Config Path
paths.description: fertilizer config storage path. Default is /mnt/user/appdata/fertilizer

paths.name: Data Path
paths.description: Path to store generated .torrent files and linked torrent data. Read the installation docs for important info.

paths.name: Torrents Path
paths.description: Path where your torrent client stores its in-progress torrents. This is the 'state' folder in Deluge or the 'BT_backup' folder in qBittorrent.

ports.name: Web Port
ports.description: Web port for server mode. Default is 9713
